objective: Locate the first compiled model boundary whose rank-0 request row differs between the cache-c000 c1 authority and the production-shape c2 run.

configuration.trace_scope: CUDAGraph replay inputs and outputs only

screen.expected_control: cache-c000 c1 matches the pinned oracle
screen.required_recurrence: cache-c000 c2 first differs at generated token 96
screen.comparison: align stable wrapper identity and replay order, then report the earliest input/output row SHA-256 mismatch

stop_rules.trace_perturbation: If c2 becomes oracle-exact, classify the full trace as synchronization-perturbative and reduce the traced boundary set before drawing a localization conclusion.
stop_rules.gpu_fault: Stop on any new GPU, Xe, Level Zero, or collective fault.
stop_rules.no_match: Do not infer a layer boundary unless request ordering and the token-96 recurrence are both proven.

host_caveat: The current boot contains a pre-existing GPU reset, so even a useful localization remains diagnostic until clean-boot confirmation.
